description: Open the Exam Anxiety dataset (already loaded or available at /home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/ExamAnxiety.csv) in Jamovi. Create a Scatterplot Matrix (Exploration > Scatterplot Matrix) to visualize the relationships between 'Exam', 'Anxiety', and 'Revise'. Group the plots by 'Gender'. Configure the plot to show 'Density' plots on the diagonal and 'Linear' regression lines on the scatterplots. Also enable 'Correlation' coefficients. Save the completed analysis as '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/ExamAnxiety_Matrix.omv'.
